name: Sleepwalk
summary: Guide an unconscious creature to move at half speed while it remains helpless.
description: The subject can move at half speed with one move action each round when led, but remains helpless and fails Strength- and Dexterity-based skill checks. Damage prompts a new save. Failure ends the spell and wakes a subject with positive hit points. Otherwise it remains unconscious when the spell ends. The spell does not heal or stabilize the target, and moving under its effect does not cause a disabled creature to resume dying.
